purpose: Measure how joint replay of exact MSM results changes 4x2 critical-path latency.
request_matches: Reuse checks the base identity and every scalar after priming.
calibration: Within each input, absolute paired median percentage difference <=2% for ordinary vs frozen and mask f vs ordinary, computed from process means.
inference: Use matched blocks for single and grouped removal deltas, and for K/B2 joint saving minus the two single savings. If either calibration fails, show descriptive measurements only. Separate traced panel cross-checks every replay hit and reports per-query elapsed spans.
scope: Measurements on Ryzen only. Replayed queries skip work using exact stored results, so derived sensitivities are diagnostic. No replay timing enters the 10x M5 scorecard.
